nina: quick sync 107: encountered truncated stream with hedging on canary. upstream1 sent until token 210 then stalled, upstream2 started at 205 and completed. client saw 205-210 duplicated then an abrupt end. link: https://canary-logs.example/trace/abc123

arjun: this is consistent with resume_token being coarse-grained. we need intra-stream coordinates. proposing minimal header X-Edge-Gen-Start and X-Edge-Gen-Count. upstreams must declare model_family in X-Edge-Model-Family.

maya: +1 for minimality. also add metric hedged_overlap_bytes and hedged_overlap_count. we'll handle billing later.

sara: careful about cross-model-family hedges. model_family mismatch -> proxy should not dedupe, just log and increment mismatch metric.

nina: implementation note: for http/2 put in HEADERS, for quic put as json prelude first data frame. doc will spell it out.

arjun: will add POC patch for h2 frame prelude parsing.

infra-bot: alert created: edge.hedge.duplicate_tokens if hedged_overlap_count > 10 in 5m.

maya: let's ship the dedupe logic without billing change as a low-risk fix. follow-up for billing.
